dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Candy is at risk due to behavioral reasons. Candy has been observed to be fearful while in care and has been noted to react negatively towards select handlers when she was previously in a crate. Candy would lunge and snarl at handlers when they attempted to interact with her. Recently Candy has also been observed to hard bark, growl, and lunge at handlers while on leash. During her assessment, Candy was observed to be social with handlers and would engage with a neutral body and wagging tail. Medically, Candy is underweight but otherwise healthy.

Candy arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Candy has been observed to be fearful. Noted to lunge and snarl at select handlers while in her crate. Recently, while on leash Candy has been observed to hard bark, growl, and lunge at handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
